tokens.v: Catch two fingertips just lifting off the surface of the dense cream, a soft peak drawn up and already slumping under its own weight, a first sheer smear warming across the top of her freckled cheekbone as the jar's cold rim rests a centimetre from that skin. 100mm macro at f/3.5, camera level with the cheekbone: the drag mark in the cream and the pore texture beside it sharp in one plane, the brass lid a warm blur behind. Her lower lashline cuts the top edge, the jar's shoulder cuts the right, and a soft strand of strawberry-blonde hair crosses the bottom edge out of focus.
